title: Check whether users can consent to apps
summary: Read the tenant's user consent setting from the authorization policy: an empty list means user consent is off.
notes: Empty output: users can't consent to apps. A value like ManagePermissionGrantsForSelf.microsoft-user-default-low: users can consent to low-risk permissions from verified publishers.
Change the setting in the Entra admin center (Enterprise apps > Consent and permissions), and turn on the admin consent workflow at the same time.
